description: Fork of exp633 (vanilla MinimalGPT + LUT FFN hybrid_smooth = 1.4584 @ 167M). Single change: replace v projection in attention with a TinyMultiHeadLut (NAP=6, tph=1024, hybrid_smooth) matching the FFN LUT shape. qkv Linear is split into qk_proj=Linear(n_embd, 2*n_embd) + v_lut=TinyMultiHeadLut(n_embd -> n_embd). Tests whether replacing the v projection with the same LUT recipe as the FFN gives further gain. Reference: exp328 vanilla = 1.3882, exp633 = 1.4584, exp634 (NAP=8 FFN) = 1.4372.
